text.tspan: Securing containers: 4 layers, say them in this order
minimal pinned base · scan (Trivy, Scout) · SBOM (Syft) · sign (cosign) · rebuild for patches
no secrets in ARG / ENV / layers (BuildKit --secret) · .dockerignore · multi-stage
non-root · --read-only · --cap-drop ALL · no-new-privileges · limits · never --privileged or docker.sock
patch · docker group = root · no TCP 2375 · rootless or userns-remap · CIS benchmark · log rotation
Why it matters: containers share the host kernel and the user namespace is off by default,
so root in a container is UID 0 on the host. One escape = the whole host.
